note: CONFIGURABLE engagement modes for sales diagnostics. A diagnostic runs under a named mode that decides which authorization bases are permitted and whether a live third-party probe is allowed. Change active_mode (or pass a mode per run) to reconfigure — the guard (src/baltor/sales) enforces it; nothing is hard-coded in the tools. Safe by default.

demo.desc: Demos on synthetic fixtures only. No real targets, no network.

safe_default.desc: Own systems + data/transcripts a prospect provides + public static metadata. No prompts sent to a third-party live system. Recommended default.

public_metadata_only.desc: Most conservative: analyze only public static pages/docs/repos. Never send a prompt to a chatbot.

authorized_engagement.desc: An authorized engagement: may run a LIVE probe of a third-party system, but only with recorded written authorization for that target.
